lines.en: One step. Another. Toward you.

lines.zh: 我知道你在哪，一直知道。
lines.en: I know where you are. Always.
I'm slow, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 我经过的树，叶子都掉了。
lines.en: The trees I pass lose their leaves.
My feet don't crush the grass.
Around this tree, then further.
As far as you go, I go.
Branches snap beside me.
The trees behind me are bare.
I keep this pace.
Stone at that wall. I go around.
I'm not far from you.

lines.zh: 我停下，可我知道你在动。
lines.en: I stop, but I know you're moving.
The leaves here are curling.
Leaves crumble at my feet.
I stand, facing your direction.
I'm always between me and you.
This tree beside me is dying.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方，你在走。
lines.en: I hear you walking, far away.
My hands hang still.
The air is heavy near me.
I count the blocks you've crossed.
The color of this grove has changed.
I can wait much longer.
No hurry. Only one road.
I've turned slightly toward you.

lines.zh: 叶子掉下来的声音很清。
lines.en: The falling leaves sound very clear.
I've started again.

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，你已经知道了。
lines.en: I've done nothing, and you already know.
Leaves wither where I pass.
You don't need to turn around.
Turn around, and there I am.
Listen. The leaves are gone.

lines.zh: 你走到这里，我走了更远。
lines.en: You came this far. I came further.
You can't quite recall my face.
I'm in no hurry. Don't rush either.
Your lamp is too bright.
I lean toward where you are.

lines.zh: 你身边那些树已经死了。
lines.en: The trees around you are dead.
Will you keep walking?
I don't need eyes to know.

lines.zh: 这里离你离开的地方很远。
lines.en: You're far from where you started.
The path behind you is gone.

lines.zh: 我不太像能受伤的东西。
lines.en: I'm not much of a thing to wound.

lines.zh: 这一下从我这过去了一点。
lines.en: That passed partway through me.
You hit me; the grass moved.
I stopped for half a second.
That thing is rather hot.
You didn't interrupt me.
I go on walking, as before.
Wounds show more on other things.
Those do nothing for me.
You raise it and step back.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西都留不住绿。
lines.en: Nothing I touch keeps its green.
Keep it away. I don't need it.
You hold it up — are you begging me?

lines.zh: 我不需要你手里的东西。
lines.en: I have no need for what you hold.
The leaves on the ground are already dead.
You should take it back.
It'll wither in your hand too.
Your food does nothing for me.
You bumped me. Lightly.
I'm colder than you expected.
Don't come closer. Trees wither.
I stepped back. I'll be back.
We don't often manage to touch.
That stopped me for an instant.
The grass at my feet yellowed.
You're still standing. Good.
Only one block between us.
We don't do this.
Two of me and the trees all die.
Don't stand there watching.
When we come close, the ground dries.
It's exactly like me.
Together we say nothing.
Afterwards we still walk toward you.
This motion makes no sound.
We need no result.
I pick up a dead leaf.
What you dropped has withered.
I lay it at a tree's root.
I collect what has withered.
Things dry out in my hand.
This wood is already hollow.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，它就没了颜色。
lines.en: I lift it and the color leaves.

lines.zh: 地上剩下的一点，我收着。
lines.en: I keep what's left on the ground.
I rarely bend down.
You're behind that dead tree.

lines.zh: 我知道你停下来喘气了。
lines.en: I know you stopped to breathe.
I didn't need to look once.

lines.zh: 你身边的东西开始枯了。
lines.en: Things around you are beginning to wither.
I won't take a wrong turn.
The distance is shrinking.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，一直走到你门口。
lines.en: I follow the dead leaves all the way to your door.
You're in the house. So am I.
I'll wait here for you to come out.
I keep walking.
Turn around. I won't hide.

lines.zh: 这一片林子被我走空了。
lines.en: I've emptied this patch of woods.
You changed direction. I follow.
I hug the wall and come slowly.
The tree fell, so the road widened.
I'm four blocks behind you.
Can you hear the footsteps?
I don't need speed. I need arrival.
Leaves keep falling beside me.
You bolted the door. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 这一条路只有一个出口。
lines.en: This road has one exit.
I merely touch you.
A patch of you went cold.
My hand moves slowly. You can see.
That turned the ground yellow.
I used very little strength.
You stepped back and the grass died.
My fingers are cold.
You pushed my hand away.
One more and I'll take you with me.
I came from the far side of the woods.
When I appeared, leaves began to fall.
A shape joined the tree shadows.
I always knew you were over here.

lines.zh: 我先有了方向，再有身体。
lines.en: First a direction. Then a body.
This tree was green a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，叶子都掉。
lines.en: Where I pass, leaves fall.
You heard the dead leaves rustle.
I'm not far from you.
The dead branches are all crackling.

lines.zh: 我把这里的绿都带走了。
lines.en: I took the green out of this place.
This stretch is my place now.
I just walked into the light here.

lines.zh: 火让这里的枯叶都燃了。
lines.en: Fire set the dead leaves burning.

lines.zh: 我没有落下去，只是被推下去。
lines.en: I didn't fall. I was pushed down.
Water cut me off from the world.

lines.zh: 爆开的气把我吹散了点。
lines.en: The blast scattered a bit of me.

lines.zh: 箭从我这穿过去，落在后面。
lines.en: The arrow went through and landed behind.
That light can touch me.
Hunger cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 雷一下子照清了这里的树。
lines.en: Lightning lit every tree here at once.

lines.zh: 这里是虚空，我反而舒服。
lines.en: This is void. I'm more comfortable here.
